function: Joint design of covert transmit beamformers (confidential and jamming signals) and RIS phase shifts maximizing sum covert rate under a sensing beampattern constraint (p. 7)
system: BS with 8-antenna ULA, 3 single-antenna users and single-antenna target; passive reflecting RIS with 20 elements, continuous phase; frequency band not stated (pp. 3-4, 10)
method: Twin-delayed DDPG (TD3-CBP) actor-critic deep reinforcement learning with two critics and penalty-based reward; trained by agent-environment interaction (pp. 8-9)
data_channel: Own simulator: Rician fading BS-RIS, RIS-user, RIS-target links, path-loss exponents 2.8/2.1/3.3, Rician factor 4, perfect CSI; no standard or measured channel (pp. 4, 10)
test_conditions: Fixed layout, M=8, N=20, K=3 (Table II); sweeps of Pmax, M, N, Rt, epsilon, rho, K; no separate training and testing conditions, no unseen scenario (pp. 10-12)
baselines: Learned only: DDPG-CBP and SAC-CBP, same problem (pp. 10-11); no classical or non-learned baseline simulated (AO and exhaustive search only discussed in text)
metrics: Sum covert transmission rate (SCTR), beampattern gain, reward versus steps for convergence (pp. 10-12)
complexity: Order of complexity O(N_epi T (...)) in state and action dimensions and hidden neurons, Eq. (54); no runtime or FLOPs (p. 9)
q1_support: p. 4: "The channel from the BS to RIS follows the Rician fading" - custom Rician links with own path loss (Table II, p. 10); no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 11: "Fig. 6 depicts the relationship between the SCTR and the antenna number M" - sweeps of system parameters only; the paper never states a model trained in one setting and tested in another, or fine-tuned.
q3_support: p. 10: "DDPG-CBP algorithm adopted in DRL literature can be used" as benchmark; SAC-CBP is also learned (p. 11); Figs. 5-9 show only learned curves, no non-learned baseline such as AO, random or fixed RIS.
q4_support: p. 9: "the complexity of the proposed TD3-CBP algorithm is described by" O(N_epi T (...)) in Eq. (54), in terms of state and action dimensions and hidden neurons.
q5_support: p. 10: "simulation results are given to evaluate the performance of the proposed TD3-CBP algorithm" - own simulation, Tables II-III list parameters only; no code or data link and no public dataset.
notes: Included as area 5: beamforming and RIS phase shifts in an RIS-aided covert ISAC system with a sensing beampattern constraint (pp. 6-7); covert transmission is not an excluded function. Title on p. 1 matches the DOI. Perfect CSI assumed (p. 4). Earlier conference version [1] cited on p. 1.
